facts.fact: The World Bank paper says the unified social registry built under the Jigiséméjiri project, holding nearly 1.2 million households at the project's close, has been used by several programs as a common targeting tool.

The paper says the RSU, holding over 60,000 poor households and almost 75,000 by March 2018, was used to identify beneficiaries of the labor-intensive public works program (launched September 2018) and the income-generating activities (launched October 2017), with RSU households given priority.

systems.owner: Government of Mali, supported by the World Bank Jigiséméjiri project

systems.system: Management information system (MIS) of the safety net project
